description: Docs drift: PUT /zones/{zone_id}/settings/zaraz/workflow takes the workflow as the raw, unquoted request body (`realtime` / `preview`). Verified 2026-10-09: a JSON object `{"workflow":"preview"}` and a JSON string `"preview"` are both rejected with 400 "Bad Request: invalid workflow value", while the bare body `preview` (any Content-Type) returns 200. Send the member as a verbatim text/plain payload.
